explainBack.prompt: Why might ChatGPT give a weaker answer when I ask it something from the floating pet controls than when I ask the same thing inside my project?
explainBack.response: Because a chat started from the floating controls begins outside any project, it cannot see the files and instructions saved in that project. ChatGPT can only use the context the surrounding product hands to the chat, and the floating panel hands it nothing from your project. The pet itself changes nothing either way — it is appearance only. To get the project's files and instructions into the conversation, you must start the chat from that project in the main app.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: An accurate answer must cite the context boundary (floating-controls chats are outside a project, P006), the general principle that a chat only uses supplied context (P009), and the appearance-only role of the pet (P003).
explainBack.assessment: The article fully supports this answer: P006 states the boundary and the remedy, P009 supplies the causal principle, and P003 rules out the pet as a variable. A reader relying only on this artifact can reconstruct the causal chain correctly.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: OpenAI’s September 11 desktop update added a quick chat to the floating Pets controls on macOS and Windows. OpenAI calls that small new chat Quick Chat. The useful part is the small control panel: you can type or speak a new request while another app is open, then use its bell to see whether a chat is running, needs your input, is ready, or is blocked.

The pet is optional animated appearance around that panel. OpenAI says choosing one changes its appearance, not how ChatGPT completes tasks. If you want the floating controls without an animal, choose Mini in Settings > Pets; Mini means the floating controls without a pet.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Say you are planning a birthday dinner in a notes app and want ChatGPT to suggest a grocery list. Paste the meal details into a quick chat from the floating controls while you use another app. That is a convenience feature. It is not a new assistant, and it does not make the grocery list more accurate.

Choose a pet if you like having it on screen, or Mini if you only want the controls. One important limit: a chat started from those floating controls is outside a project. If you need the files and instructions saved in a project, start the chat from that project in the main app instead.
